rule: If a claim starts to feel bigger than the evidence, stop and read the matching fence line out loud. The fence is the story here, not a disclaimer.

rows.say: A working hypothesis on an attainable path toward General Natural Intelligence, natural not artificial, tested in the open.

rows.never: It sees, wants, feels, understands, is aware, is conscious, is alive.
